objective: Check whether original K-eligible positive native-unit numeric morphology records in major floristic AusTraits sources carry method-context flags for genus/family/taxonomic inference, potentially imposing phylogenetic correlation into source trait values.

record_eligibility.original: Same original source-native units, species-rank, binomial, unambiguous genus, original dataset_id+observation_id and finite original numeric median>0 species state as primary K analysis.
record_eligibility.positive_source_record: Only a finite positive original measurement from one of five fixed flora datasets contributing to an original K-eligible species-system cell.
record_eligibility.context_field: method_context_properties from flattened 68-column original AusTraits parquet, not merely available method categories from source metadata.
record_eligibility.de_duplicate: Dedup original K records without context to reproduce state medians; for each original record key+value, aggregate method context evidence by ANY flag, without duplicating observation counts.
record_eligibility.precedence: Higher-taxonomic inference indicators may co-occur; report each flag's own counts and the union of family+genus+taxonomy, never sum overlapping flags as independent records.

report: Audit all original 254 K native species-median cell support exactly; fail if a single original system count differs.
Per dataset×named trait counts of positive original observation keys and unique species×system cells, counts carrying genus/family/taxonomic inference versus scored text, and unknown context.

Aggregate 5-flora input counts and family×trait system representation, with a clear NONCLAIM that method-context flags might be incomplete and direct scoring is not guaranteed direct specimen measurement.
No K recalculation, no selection of favorable named traits or taxa, no species names/trait measurement values/observation IDs exported.
If no readable record method contexts exist for relevant traits, mark original source-inference mechanism UNTESTED, not ruled out.
ethics_and_scope: Entire audit is exploratory after the original 760 K outcomes, the 279 same-source K outcomes and biological grouping; its aim is critical measurement validity, not a new positive evolutionary-process hypothesis.

The presence of a higher-taxon inference category in ABRS metadata alone does not establish it was used in any numerical K state; only the actual original record method context can adjudicate observed incidence.

Even if genus/family flags are absent, numerical trait values extracted from species flora descriptions are not independently sampled physical individuals. Absence of evidence in one context field does not prove independent measurement.
Original homogeneous OU/source classifier and closed BIEN 201-system rho study are not reopened.
